mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_chat_message_reactions (message_id, member_id, reaction_type) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{memberId}, #{reactionType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reaction_type = #{reactionType}, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT r.message_id AS message_id, r.reaction_type AS reaction_type, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(r.member_id = #{memberId}) AS reacted FROM travel_plan_chat_message_reactions r WHERE r.message_id IN
#{messageId}
GROUP BY r.message_id, r.reaction_type
ORDER BY r.message_id ASC, r.reaction_type ASC
